{{Quote|Mighty Jabba, to date Solo has failed to make good on cargo lot #3207D. He ridiculously claims that he was forced to jettison the shipment due to the untimely arrival of an Imperial cruiser.|[[Calk Fen]] in a report of Jabba the Hutt|<ref name="Balancing">{{WEGCite|story=Balancing the Books|book=The Star Wars Sourcebook}}</ref>}}
'''#3207D''' was a cargo lot containing [[Spice/Legends|spice]] that the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was contracted to carry for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] which was valued at 12,400 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Solo jettisoned the cargo into [[Realspace/Legends|space]] when confronted by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]]. The loss of the spice, and the subsequent costs to Jabba's [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|organization]], resulted in a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] being placed on Solo's head.<ref name="Balancing" />
